{
  "phoneNote": "The tall framed introduction pushes meaningful flower imagery below the first screen, while repeated contact sections make the page unnecessarily long.",
  "desktopNote": "The framed typography and arched image feel designed, but the repeated bouquet photo and duplicated contact section weaken an otherwise coherent layout.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 2,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 4,
    "hierarchy": 3,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Shorten the phone hero’s framed panel and decorative spacing so a prominent bouquet image appears in the first screen; make ordering flowers the primary hero action.",
    "Replace the reused bouquet in the gift section with a distinct image of potted plants or gift baskets, and keep image labels fully inside their crops.",
    "Consolidate the address, opening hours and contact details into one section, leaving a compact legal footer; reduce oversized desktop section padding and the dominant year display."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone and desktop: the bouquet photo is repeated in the hero inset and gift section.",
    "Phone and desktop: the footer repeats the address, directions and opening-hours block immediately after the contact section.",
    "Phone and desktop: image attribution text is clipped in the small shaped photo crops."
  ]
}
